programs.title: Tournament of Champions
programs.desc: Fieri welcomes the Great 8 back into the arena to compete in the tough quarterfinals; eight of the world's best chefs go head-to-head in four sudden death battles and deal with the randomizer to earn a trip to the finale.

programs.title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
programs.desc: Jesse Palmer asks the remaining four chefs to create arctic-themed cakes with a frozen layer; the top two chefs move on to the finale, and the bottom two chefs battle in a sudden-death round, hoping to impress judges Duff Goldman and Molly Yeh.

programs.title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
programs.desc: Jesse Palmer challenges the final three chefs to create a spectacular dessert display inspired by one of three themes; Judges Duff Goldman, Shinmin Li, Jacques Torres, and Sherry Yard decide who will win $50,000 and the title of Ultimate Baking Champion.

programs.title: 24 in 24: Last Chef Standing
programs.desc: Michael Symon and Esther Choi give the remaining chefs three challenges that test their ability to think and cook fast, including a team relay race and a 15-minute fast-food dish. Expert judge Judy Joo sends two chefs home.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Guy enlists the help of his mom, Penny, and his wife, Lori, in his Mother's Day Games featuring mom/kid teams who run family restaurants together; four unique sample ingredients to feature in their top seller, a "Prized Family Recipe" ingredients.
